Elderwood.name: Elderwood
Elderwood.desc: Gain placeable Elderwood plants. (@MinUnits@) A Stonebark Tree and a Lifebloom (@MinUnits@) A second Stonebark Tree and Stonebark Trees gain @StonebarkTreeBonusHealth@ Health (@MinUnits@) and the Deepwood Protector (@MinUnits@) Plants star up to 2-star (@MinUnits@) Plants star up to 3-star and the forest comes to life

Avatar.name: Avatar
Avatar.desc: Having an Avatar on your bench or board transforms all other Avatars in your shop to the Trait of that Avatar. An Avatar's chosen Trait is counted twice for Trait bonuses.

Ravager.name: Ravager
Ravager.desc: Ravagers gain @Omnivamp*100@% Omnivamp. Additionally, Ravagers deal bonus damage, doubled against units below @EnemyHealthThreshold*100@% Health. (@MinUnits@) @BonusDamagePercentBase*100@% Bonus Damage (@MinUnits@) @BonusDamagePercentBase*100@% Bonus Damage (@MinUnits@) @BonusDamagePercentBase*100@% Bonus Damage

BountySeeker.name: Bounty Seeker
BountySeeker.desc: Choose a bounty. Your strongest Draven can progress on the bounty to earn its reward. Upon completing a bounty, choose another.

Solar.name: Solar
Solar.desc: (@MinUnits@) Your champions gain a @ShieldRatio*100@% max Health shield and deal @BonusMagicDamage*100@% bonus magic damage. Gain additional bonuses for each unique 3-star champion: 1 : Increase shield and magic damage by @PercentIncreasePer3Star*100@% for each 3-star. @NumThreeStarThreshold1@ : @Threshold1AttackSpeed*100@% %i:scaleAS% and @Threshold1ArmorMagicResist@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% @NumThreeStarThreshold2@ : Convert @Threshold2TrueDamageConversion*100@% of the bonus magic damage to true damage. @NumThreeStarThreshold3@ : Every @Threshold3StarUpPeriod@ seconds of combat, a 3-star champion ascends to 4-star.

Sprykin.name: Sprykin
Sprykin.desc: Gain the Big Furry Friend. Drop a Sprykin on the BFF to pick its Rider. (@MinUnits@) The Rider gains @HealthIncrease*100@% %i:scaleHealth% and @AttackSpeedIncrease*100@% %i:scaleAS% (@MinUnits@) @HealthIncrease*100@% %i:scaleHealth% @AttackSpeedIncrease*100@% %i:scaleAS%, and @TeamwideRatio*100@% of the BFF's Ability applies to your Sprykin champions. (@MinUnits@) @HealthIncrease*100@% %i:scaleHealth% @AttackSpeedIncrease*100@% %i:scaleAS%, and @TeamwideRatio*100@% of the BFF's Ability applies to your Sprykin champions.

Adaptor.name: Adaptor
Adaptor.desc: Innate: Adaptor abilities change depending on if their Attack Damage or Ability Power is higher. Adaptors gain Ability Power or Attack Damage, depending on which is higher. (@MinUnits@) @ADAPGain*100@% OR (@MinUnits@) @ADAPGain*100@% OR (@MinUnits@) @ADAPGain*100@% OR

Coven.name: Coven
Coven.desc: Gather Essence by killing champions, plus more by losing player combat. Beginning at @EssenceForRitualTooltip@ Essence, choose to convert Essence to rewards or continue gathering Essence. Each reward requires increasing amounts of Essence. (@MinUnits@) @EssencePerDeath@ Essence per kill, @EssencePerLoss@ Essence per loss (@MinUnits@) @EssencePerDeath@ per kill, @EssencePerLoss@ per loss (@MinUnits@) @EssencePerDeath@ per kill, @EssencePerLoss@ per loss (@MinUnits@) @EssencePerDeath@ per kill, @EssencePerLoss@ per loss

Hunter.name: Hunter
Hunter.desc: Hunters gain Attack Damage. If a Hunter hasn't swapped targets for @HunterDuration@ seconds, they gain @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp. (@MinUnits@) @HunterAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% (@MinUnits@) @HunterAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% (@MinUnits@) @HunterAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% (@MinUnits@) @HunterAD*100@% %i:scaleAD%

OldGrowth.name: Old Growth
OldGrowth.desc: Whenever an enemy within @UniqueTraitHexRange@ hexes dies, gain @UniqueTraitHealthPerStack@ permanent max Health. Current: 0

Monolith.name: Monolith
Monolith.desc: Monoliths gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for each enemy targeting them.

Primal.name: Primal
Primal.desc: Choose one of four Primal Blessings. (@MinUnits@) (@MinUnits@)

Greenfather.name: Greenfather
Greenfather.desc: Gain @SeedsPerCast@ seed when your strongest Ivern casts, plus @CombatStartSeeds@ every combat. Ivern uses @SeedsToGrowHex@ seeds to grow a hex on your board that grants a bonus to its occupant. Seeds: 0 / @SeedsToGrowHex@ Current Biome:

Invoker.name: Invoker
Invoker.desc: Your team gains Mana Regen, increased for Invokers. (@MinUnits@) @TeamManaRegen@ %i:scaleManaRegen% | @InvokerManaBonus@ %i:scaleManaRegen% (@MinUnits@) @TeamManaRegen@ %i:scaleManaRegen% | @InvokerManaBonus@ %i:scaleManaRegen% (@MinUnits@) @TeamManaRegen@ %i:scaleManaRegen% | @InvokerManaBonus@ %i:scaleManaRegen% (@MinUnits@) @TeamManaRegen@ %i:scaleManaRegen% | @InvokerManaBonus@ %i:scaleManaRegen%

Rapidfire.name: Rapidfire
Rapidfire.desc: Your team gains @TeamAS*100@% Attack Speed. Rapidfire champions gain more on every attack, up to @MaxStacks@ stacks. (@MinUnits@) +@ASPerAttack*100@% %i:scaleAS% per Attack (@MinUnits@) +@ASPerAttack*100@% %i:scaleAS% per Attack (@MinUnits@) +@ASPerAttack*100@% %i:scaleAS% per Attack (@MinUnits@) +@ASPerAttack*100@% %i:scaleAS% per Attack

Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
Juggernaut.desc: Your team gains Durability. Juggernauts gain more. (@MinUnits@) @TeamDurability*100@% %i:scaleDR% or @JuggernautDurability*100@% %i:scaleDR% (@MinUnits@) @TeamDurability*100@% %i:scaleDR% or @JuggernautDurability*100@% %i:scaleDR% (@MinUnits@) @TeamDurability*100@% %i:scaleDR% or @JuggernautDurability*100@% %i:scaleDR%

Inferno.name: Inferno
Inferno.desc: Inferno damage Burns and @WoundPercent@% Wounds enemies for @Duration@ seconds. Inferno Burns stack with other Burns. (@MinUnits@) @HPBurnPerSecond@% Burn (@MinUnits@) After combat, @LuckySlotCount@ of your shop slots without an Inferno champion ignites, rolling a champion one tier higher (@MinUnits@) Ignite @LuckySlotCount@ shop slots, @HPBurnPerSecond@% Burn (@MinUnits@) Ignite @LuckySlotCount@ shop slots, @HPBurnPerSecond@% Burn

Attuned.name: Attuned
Attuned.desc: Your strongest Alune cycles to a new phase of the moon after each cast. While the moon is at or below half full, your team gains @Durability*100@% Durabilty. While above, your team gains @DamageAmp*100@% Damage Amp.

Rival.name: Rival
Rival.desc: (@MinUnits@) Only active while fielding 1 Rival. Rivals collect takedowns, gaining 3 if they takedown another Rival. (@MinUnits@) Rivals collect takedowns, gaining 3 if they takedown another Rival. Takedowns evolve Kha'Zix, permanently granting him your choice of Executioner, Rapidfire, Ravager, or Spellweaver. Rengar grants @RengarGold@/@RengarGold_2@/@RengarGold_3@ gold every @RengarStackReq@ takedowns. After @RengarADStackReq@ takedowns, your team gains @RengarThresholdAD*100@% Attack Damage plus @RengarADPerStack*100@% %i:scaleAD% per additional takedown. Kha'Zix Takedowns: 0 / 0 Rengar Takedowns: 0 Gold Earned: 0 (@MinUnits@) Rivals can be fielded together. When Kha'Zix gains Mana from his Ability, Rengar gains @Augment_RengarManaPercent*100@% of that Mana. When Rengar heals from his Ability, Kha'Zix gains @Augment_KhaZixHealPercent*100@% of that heal.

Vanguard.name: Vanguard
Vanguard.desc: At Combat Start and after dropping below @HealthThreshold*100@% Health, Vanguards gain a max Health Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. (@MinUnits@) @MaxHealthShield*100@% max Health (@MinUnits@) @MaxHealthShield*100@% max Health (@MinUnits@) @MaxHealthShield*100@% max Health. Gain @DurabilityIncrease*100@% Durability while Shielded.

Brawler.name: Brawler
Brawler.desc: Your team gains @BrawlerTeamHealth@ max Health. Brawlers gain more. (@MinUnits@) @BrawlerHealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth% (@MinUnits@) @BrawlerHealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth% (@MinUnits@) @BrawlerHealthPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%

Blackthorn.name: Blackthorn
Blackthorn.desc: The ally on the Blackthorn hex is sacrificed before combat, granting your champions Health. Blackthorn champions gain additional stats based on the sacrifice's Role, Star Level, and Cost. (@MinUnits@) @Health@ %i:scaleHealth% (@MinUnits@) @Health@ %i:scaleHealth%; Bonus is @StatMultiplier*100@% stronger (@MinUnits@) @Health@ %i:scaleHealth%; The sacrifice doesn't die. It also gains: @Tier3BonusAD*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%, @Tier3BonusAttackSpeed*100@% %i:scaleAS%, @Tier3BonusArmor@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%, @Tier3BonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%, @Tier3BonusOmnivamp*100@%

Executioner.name: Executioner
Executioner.desc: (@MinUnits@) Executioners gain Precision and @CritChance*100@% Critical Strike Chance. (@MinUnits@) Additionally, enemies bleed for @BonusBleedPercent*100@% bonus true damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. (@MinUnits@) Bleed damage increased to @BonusBleedPercent*100@%.

ApexPredator.name: Apex Predator
ApexPredator.desc: Elder Dragon takes up 2 team slots and grants +2 to the Riftbeast trait.

Riftbeast.name: Riftbeast
Riftbeast.desc: (@MinUnits@) Use the Alpha Mark to grant a Riftbeast their unique Buff (@MinUnits@) Every @OverrunCombats@ combats, your next shop is overrun with Riftbeasts. (@MinUnits@) On combat start and every 5 seconds Riftbeasts grow gaining @CapstoneAD*100@% %i:scaleAD% @CapstoneAP*100@% %i:scaleAP% @CapstoneAspd*100@% %i:scaleAS% +@CapstoneArmor@ %i:scaleArmor% +@CapstoneMR@ %i:scaleMR% +@CapstoneHealth@ %i:scaleHealth% +@CapstoneManaRegen@ %i:scaleManaRegen% (@MinUnits@) +@TeamSize@ maximum team size

Caustic.name: Caustic
Caustic.desc: Caustic damage @ShredPercent@% Shreds and Sunders enemies for @ShredDuration@ seconds.

Fae.name: Fae
Fae.desc: Your team's damage, healing, and shielding attracts Pixies. Each Pixie grants Fae champions Attack Damage and Ability Power, and after they fall below @HealThreshold*100@% Health, they heal for each Pixie. (@MinUnits@) @ADAP@% and @Heal@% Heal. (@MinUnits@) @ADAP@% and @Heal@% Heal. After attracting 7 Pixies, start attracting Golden Pixies instead which grant gold.

Lunar.name: Lunar
Lunar.desc: Lunar champions and adjacent allies gain Attack Speed and Ability Power. Lunar champions gain @LunarMultiplier*100@% more. (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeed*100@% %i:scaleAS%, @AbilityPower*100@% %i:scaleAP% (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeed*100@% %i:scaleAS%, @AbilityPower*100@% %i:scaleAP% (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeed*100@% %i:scaleAS%, @AbilityPower*100@% %i:scaleAP% (@MinUnits@) @AttackSpeed*100@% %i:scaleAS%, @AbilityPower*100@% %i:scaleAP%

Defender.name: Defender
Defender.desc: Your team gains @NonDefenderDefenseGain@ Armor and Magic Resist. Defenders gain more. (@MinUnits@) @DefenderDefenseGain@ (@MinUnits@) @DefenderDefenseGain@ (@MinUnits@) @DefenderDefenseGain@

Spellweaver.name: Spellweaver
Spellweaver.desc: Your team gains @TeamwideAP*100@% Ability Power. Spellweavers gain more, plus extra Ability Power whenever a Spellweaver casts an Ability. (@MinUnits@) @SpellweaverAP*100@% %i:scaleAP%, +@APPerCast*100@% %i:scaleAP% per cast (@MinUnits@) @SpellweaverAP*100@% %i:scaleAP%, +@APPerCast*100@% %i:scaleAP% per cast (@MinUnits@) @SpellweaverAP*100@% %i:scaleAP%, +@APPerCast*100@% %i:scaleAP% per cast

Thornmaiden.name: Thornmaiden
Thornmaiden.desc: Your team gains @BaseDurability*100@% Durability, increased to @IncreasedDurability*100@% if @PlantNumThreshold@ or more Zyra plants are alive.

FloraFatalis.name: Flora Fatalis
FloraFatalis.desc: Flora Fatalis champions harvest enemies on takedown, gaining: (@MinUnits@) @Mana@ Mana (@MinUnits@) and grant a @PercentHeal*100@% max Health heal to the lowest Health ally.

Summoner.name: Summoner
Summoner.desc: Summoners empower their summons in different ways. Yorick: +@HealthMult*100@% Health Azir: +@DamageMult*100@% Damage Mama Beak: +@DamageMult*100@% Damage Zyra: +@NumExtraAttacks@ Plant Attacks (@MinUnits@) Empower Summons (@MinUnits@) Improve each effect by 50%

Blossom.name: Blossom
Blossom.desc: After combat, your Wisps are empowered. Blossom champions gain Attack Damage, Ability Power, and @BonusHealth*100@% max Health. (@MinUnits@) Wisps are upgraded, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% (@MinUnits@) Wisps are in every shop, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% (@MinUnits@) Gain @GoldPerCharmPurchased@ gold after buying a Wisp, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% (@MinUnits@) You can buy 2 Wisps per round, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% (@MinUnits@) Wisps overflow with power, @ADAP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

EmeraldAspect.name: Emerald Aspect
EmeraldAspect.desc: Drag an ally onto your strongest Taric to pair them, granting the ally powerful bonuses from Taric's ability.

ability.name: Kunai Strike
ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</Bright> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. If the target is <keyword>Burning</keyword>, deal an additional @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</dim>

ability.name: Defensive Sweep
ability.desc: Slice the target for @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and gain @AbilityShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Razor Leaves
ability.desc:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and applying @WoundLevel@% <Keyword>Wound</Keyword> and @BurnAmount@% <Keyword>Burn</Keyword> for @WoundDuration@ seconds.

<bright>Scarlet Buff:</bright> Cinderling gains @TraitADOnCast@ Attack Damage each cast.

<rules>Wound: Reduces healing received.</rules>
<rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.</rules>

ability.name: Karmic Bond
ability.desc: Tether the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @TetherDuration@ seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all enemies in a @AoEHexRange@ Hex radius and @SlowPercent@% <keyword>Slowing</keyword> them for @SlowDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>

ability.name: Dance of Life
ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health over @Duration@ seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Shield Bash
ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Start combat with @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over @DecayDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Bash the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Bellows Breath
ability.desc: <Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a cone. \n\n<Bright>Quest:</Bright> Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, doubled at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. <Rules>(Forge Power: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules> / </Rules>@GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>

ability.name: Azure Laser
ability.desc: Begin consuming @PercentManaPerSecond@ max Mana per second and channeling a laser on target. Each second while casting, deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by @MRReduction@.\n\n<Bright>Teal Buff:</Bright> Gain @TraitManaRegenTooltip@ Mana Regen for every @TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@ seconds channeled.

ability.name: Entrancing Dance
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% decaying Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Uproot
ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Restore @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% Health each second, tripled for @SpellMultiplierDuration@ seconds after casting.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them.

ability.name: Piercing Arrow
ability.desc: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

ability.name: Primordial Burst
ability.desc:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, increased to @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% if they're below @HPThreshold@ max Health.

If they die, permanently gain @APOnKill@% Ability Power.

Current bonus: @Stack@% %i:scaleAP%

ability.name: Deadly Plumage
ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and reduce Armor by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%.

ability.name: Last Rites
ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% max Health.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and strike the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.

ability.name: Triumphant Roar
ability.desc: Roar, restoring @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP%. Then slam the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Headshot
ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage.

ability.name: Spider Queen
ability.desc: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage and heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%. Subsequent casts grant @DecayingAS@ decaying Attack Speed for @ASBuffDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Belchy Bubble
ability.desc:
<Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</Bright> Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @PoisonDurationAP@ seconds.

<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Heavily slows the target.</dim>

<bright>Purple Buff:</bright> Every @TraitTimer@ seconds, Gromp gains @TraitTimedAP@ Ability Power.

ability.name: Solar Judgement
ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 

<Bright>1st Ascension:</Bright> Attacks deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks @ShredLevel@% <Keyword>Shred</Keyword> enemies hit for @ShredDuration@ seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks fire waves, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</Bright> Gain infinite range. Every @NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger.

<Rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</Rules>

ability.name: Mirror Image
ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a @PercentChanceToPrint@ chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by @PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus@ per takedown.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% to adjacent enemies.

ability.name: Rending Claws
ability.desc: Leap to the lowest Health enemy within @LeapHexRadius@ Hexes and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. The next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks gain @EmpowerAspd@ Attack Speed and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% bonus physical damage.\n\n<Bright>Grey Buff:</Bright> Gain Precision and @TraitBaseCrit@ Critical Strike Chance, increased up to @TraitBonusCrit@ based on missing Health.

ability.name: Can You Dig It?
ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

<bright>Active:</bright> Burrow underground, gaining @BurrowDurability@ Durability for @BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% over the duration. 

<bright>Green Buff:</bright> When allies fall below @TraitHealthThreshold@ Health, they restore @TraitPercentHeal@ max Health.

ability.name: Sun's Wrath
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then, cleave in a cone dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies hit.

ability.name: Ki Barrier
ability.desc: Grant @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield to Shen and @ShieldCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% Shield to a nearby damaged ally for @MagicShieldDuration@ seconds. Both of their next @NumAttacksBuff@ attacks gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage.

ability.name: Fungus Among Us
ability.desc:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to the @NumEnemiesHit@ nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to target.

Each cast has a @PercentChanceOfForage@ chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.

<bright>Red:</bright> @RedRerolls@ Reroll  <Rules>(Reds Foraged: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Green:</bright> @GreenHealth@ Tactician Health <Rules>(Greens Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Yellow:</bright> @YellowXP@ XP <Rules>(Yellows Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</Rules>

ability.name: Jaws of The Beast
ability.desc: Bite the current target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage and healing for @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% of the damage dealt. Gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

ability.name: Cultivation of Spirit
ability.desc: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and splits, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to @NumSecondaryTargets@ nearby enemies.

ability.name: Arise!
ability.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and summon @SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per attack.

ability.name: Noxious Blast
ability.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out a moonlight orb to the closest @NumOrbs@ enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Harvest
ability.desc: Reduce the Magic Resist of the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies by @MRReduction@. Then drain life from them over @CastDuration@ seconds, healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each over the duration.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread
ability.desc: Gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Taste Their Fear
ability.desc: Leap to the farthest enemy within @LeapRangeHexes@ Hexes, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage instead and gain @IsolateManaGrant@ mana.

ability.name: Raining Artillery
ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor</Bright> %i:scaleAD%<Bright>:</Bright> Launch acid at the target and the nearest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage. Enemies below @ADBonusDamageThreshold@ max Health take @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage instead.\n\n<dim>Adaptor</dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: Damages enemies over time.</dim>

ability.name: Rock and Roll
ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth% damage.

<Bright>Slate Buff:</Bright> On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for @TraitShieldHealth@ max Health.

ability.name: Wuju Style
ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed.

<Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAD%: Double Strikes grant @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% stacking Attack Speed.

<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAP%<dim>: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.</dim>

ability.name: Defensive Ball Curl
ability.desc: Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield and @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist.\n\nWhen the Shield breaks, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% physical damage to enemies in @DamageHexRange@ Hexes.

ability.name: Savagery
ability.desc: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within @JumpHexRange@ hexes and stab them, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. Then heal for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, increased to up to @HealthCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% based on their missing Health.

ability.name: Explosive Charge
ability.desc: Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. While active, gain infinite range and @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage + @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% for each attack while casting.\n\n<Rules>If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.</Rules>

ability.name: Furious Fists
ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> On attack, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Health.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Unleash a primal roar, restoring @HealthCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Then gain @SpellAS@ Attack Speed, @SpellDurability@ Durability, and is Unstoppable for @SpellDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Spirit Bomb
ability.desc: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies in a @HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@ per hex away from the epicenter.

ability.name: Tantrum
ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every second, restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Health and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @PassiveHexRadius@ hex.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies within @BigHexRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds, increased to @GenericCalc1@ seconds if the target is <Keyword>Burning</Keyword>.

<Rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.</Rules>

ability.name: Azure Shockwave
ability.desc:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage, and are <keyword>Mana Reaved</keyword> for @ManaReaveFlat@.

<Bright>Blue Buff:</Bright> Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen.

<rules>Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.</rules>

ability.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
ability.desc: Equip Severum and swipe the target @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAS% times over @Duration@ seconds, each dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage. \n\nAfter the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

ability.name: Crimson Fury
ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage.

<bright>Active:</bright> Gain @FrenzyADPercent@ Attack Damage for @Duration@ seconds. During this time ignore @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Armor.

<bright>Red Buff:</bright> Attacks @BurnAmount@% <Keyword>Burn</Keyword> enemies and heal Brambleback for @TraitMaxHealthHeal@ max Health.

ability.name: Nature's Wrath
ability.desc: Blink away from the current target, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them, and gain @AttackSpeedCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Attack Speed. \n\nEvery 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Nature's Wrath and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

ability.name: Lilting Lullaby
ability.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health and send @NumEnemiesToFireAt@ butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage and Sleep for @SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take @DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @WakeupDamage@ max Health magic damage.

ability.name: Petrified Bark
ability.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR% magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.

ability.name: Withering Curse
ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a dark blast at @NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to them and cursing them for @SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @MagicDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAP% more damage per curse.

ability.name: Javelin Toss
ability.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright>%i:scaleAP%<Bright>:</Bright> Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim>%i:scaleAD%<dim>: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.</dim>

ability.name: Haymaker
ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Upon falling below @ManaHPThreshold@ max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP% before dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD% physical damage in a large cone.

ability.name: Boomerang Blade
ability.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage to the current target and bounces @NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.

ability.name: Starcall
ability.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Rampant Growth
ability.desc: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.desc: Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage each.\n\nIf the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.desc:
Fire an arrow through the longest line of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). 

The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% <Keyword>Slows</Keyword> them.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>

ability.name: Whirling Death
ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@ bonus physical damage and apply @SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to all enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage.

ability.name: Heat Without Equal
ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Become untargetable and fly into the air, gaining @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp. Upon returning, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds and Ignite them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds. Then replace subsequent casts with Flame Breath and immediately cast it. Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</Bright>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP% physical damage and Igniting them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds

<bright>Elder Dragon Buff:</bright> Damaging an enemy below @TraitExecuteThreshold@ Health executes them.

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack. 

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%, and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

<Bright>Grab n' Throw:</Bright> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAD% physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

ability.name: Triggerseed
ability.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Shields from this Ability can critically strike with <Keyword>Precision</Keyword>. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleDA% Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@ Damage Amp for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.

ability.name: Firestorm
ability.desc: Charge up, gaining @APPerBurningEnemy@ Ability Power per <Keyword>Burning</Keyword> enemy. Then, gain @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage to each. \n\nAfter rushing, unleash a @FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleAP% magic damage split among all enemies hit over @FirestormDuration@ seconds.

ability.name: Sow the Seeds
ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> After every @DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage. On death, @SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc2@ %i:scaleHealth% magic damage to target and restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% + @ActiveMissingHealthHeal@ missing Health.

ability.name: Emerald Radiance
ability.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @PassivePercentHealthThreshold@ Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @ShieldCalc1@ %i:scaleHealth% Shield to allies within @PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @MagicDamageCalc1@ %i:scaleAP% bonus magic damage on their next @NumAttacks@ attacks.
